title: Simplicity is a viewpoint
description: 15-second Quiet Bands showcase: a structured system crowds into complexity, stops, and is cleared by one orange point that becomes the full stop of the line.

scenes.title: Structure
scenes.purpose: Open restrained: a system exists before anything goes wrong with it.
scenes.content: A lattice of small crosses; COMPLEXITY rises through its baseline.
scenes.composition: Black ground, 6 × 10 lattice filling the safe area, headline set flush left at full content width above centre.
scenes.transition: The first clutter arrives before the scene ends, so the title never sits alone as a card.
scenes.audioCue: Soft ticks as the lattice assembles; a low thump as the word lands.

scenes.title: Overload
scenes.purpose: Show coordination overhead piling up until it is unbearable, then stop it dead.
scenes.content: Lines, boxes, circles, chores (FOLLOW-UP, RE: RE: FWD, STATUS?) and outlined echoes of COMPLEXITY, arriving faster and faster.
scenes.composition: Everything snaps to the lattice; the camera pushes in 7% with accelerating ease.
scenes.transition: Hard freeze at 5.6s: build, camera and sound stop on the same frame.
scenes.audioCue: A tick per arrival over a rising swell; digital silence at the freeze.

scenes.title: Clearing
scenes.purpose: One point of view moves through the mess and removes what is not needed.
scenes.content: An orange point crosses the frame on the headline's rule; everything it passes un-draws in a ripple; the rule stays behind it.
scenes.composition: Camera eases back to rest. What remains: the word, one rule, four registration corners and the point.
scenes.transition: Continuous: the resolved layout is the first frame of the reveal.
scenes.audioCue: A soft air move with the point; nothing else.

scenes.title: The viewpoint
scenes.purpose: Deliver the line by changing the word, not replacing it.
scenes.content: COMPLEXITY becomes SIMPLICITY (M P L I T Y hold, C O E X roll through), then IS A, then VIEWPOINT; the orange point lands as its full stop.
scenes.composition: Three-line block centred in the safe area; heavy condensed display against a small medium-weight connective line; generous black above and below.
scenes.transition: The full stop stays when the words leave.
scenes.audioCue: A low tone under the swap; one crisp tick when the full stop lands.

scenes.title: Identity
scenes.purpose: Resolve to Quiet Bands and hold.
scenes.content: The words drop away; the point travels to centre and opens into the mark; the wordmark rises; quietbands.com.
scenes.composition: Lockup centred in the safe area, URL beneath in dim cream.
scenes.transition: Final hold of just over a second, nothing moving.
scenes.audioCue: One warm tone as the mark opens, decaying into the hold.

accent-pass.description: The orange point: enters left on the rule, crosses, waits, lands as VIEWPOINT's full stop, then moves to the mark's centre.

layers.note: The system. Corners survive the clearing as registration marks.
